name: codegraph
description: AI-aware architecture analysis engine for Python. Extracts structural graphs, annotates intent, detects violations, and advises on architecture evolution.

subsystems.name: core_engine
subsystems.description: Graph extraction and construction pipeline. Parses Python AST, builds structural graph (graph0), classifies layers, filters edges, builds call-graph workflow.

components.name: extractor
components.description: AST parser. Extracts nodes (functions, classes, modules) from Python source files.

components.name: python_extractor
components.description: Language-specific extractor for Python files.

components.name: javascript_extractor
components.description: Language-specific extractor for JavaScript, TypeScript, and React files. Uses regex-based parsing.

components.name: workflow_builder
components.description: Builds function-level call graph (workflow.json) from extracted AST data.

components.name: layers
components.description: Classifies nodes into layers: stdlib, external, internal_lib, project, test.

components.name: filters
components.description: Edge filtering pipeline removing stdlib, dunder, test-harness, and logging edges.

components.name: annotator
components.description: Manages intent annotations (graph1). Tracks body hashes to detect stale intents.

components.name: api_linker
components.description: Cross-language API endpoint linker. Detects backend HTTP endpoints and frontend API calls, creates workflow edges between them.

subsystems.name: models
subsystems.description: Pure data models. Dataclasses with serialization only — no business logic, no engine imports. Other subsystems depend on models, never the reverse.

components.name: graph0_model
components.description: Structural graph model. Nodes represent functions, classes, modules.

components.name: graph1_model
components.description: Intent annotation model. Semantic layer over graph0.

components.name: graph2_model
components.description: Semantic behavior model. Actions, side effects, data flow.

components.name: workflow_model
components.description: Call graph edge model with confidence and type metadata.

components.name: suggested_workflow_model
components.description: Architecture policy rule model. Rule types: required_call, forbidden_call, forbidden_path, layer_boundary, dependency_limit.

components.name: tasks_model
components.description: Task queue model for agent work items.

components.name: agent_response_model
components.description: Agent response model for repair actions and intent proposals.

components.name: validation
components.description: JSON schema validation for all model types.

components.name: factories
components.description: Factory functions for creating model instances with defaults.

subsystems.name: governance
subsystems.description: Architecture enforcement. Analyzes graphs for violations, generates task queues, applies repairs, manages policy rules.

components.name: analyzer
components.description: Main analysis engine. Detects orphans, missing imports, policy violations, stale intents, coverage gaps.

components.name: suggest
components.description: Policy rule manager. Loads/saves rules, detects violations against actual workflow.

components.name: tasks
components.description: Task generator. Converts analysis findings into prioritized agent work items.

components.name: apply
components.description: Repair orchestrator. Coordinates lock, backup, conflict detection, action dispatch, and validation.

components.name: apply_handlers
components.description: AST code manipulation helpers and repair action handlers. Extracted from apply.py.

components.name: delta
components.description: Incremental graph updates. Detects changed files via git and updates graph/workflow.

subsystems.name: intelligence
subsystems.description: Architecture analysis and advisory. Detects smells, computes metrics, plans improvements, generates dashboards.

components.name: architecture_advisor
components.description: Detects architecture smells: god modules, cycles, high fan-in/out, hidden coupling, deep dependencies.

components.name: arch_schema
components.description: Architecture definition models. Subsystems, components, edges, constraints.

components.name: arch_planner
components.description: Decomposes architecture definition into granular agent-executable tasks.

components.name: arch_viewer
components.description: Generates interactive HTML architecture dashboard.

components.name: arch_health
components.description: Architecture health scoring with per-module health grades.

components.name: arch_diff
components.description: Compares two architecture snapshots to detect drift.

components.name: risk_metrics
components.description: Graph-theoretic risk metrics: fan-in, fan-out, betweenness centrality.

components.name: refactor
components.description: Structural analysis: Tarjan SCC cycle detection, god module detection, coupling metrics.

components.name: subsystem
components.description: Community detection via Louvain algorithm. Groups nodes into subsystems.

components.name: arch_search
components.description: Multi-candidate architecture search engine. Generates, simulates, scores, and ranks architecture improvement candidates.

components.name: arch_memory_intelligence
components.description: Memory intelligence layer. Pattern mining, metrics history, strategy effectiveness scoring, feedback loop.

components.name: arch_policy
components.description: Architecture policy engine. Higher-level policies with evaluation gates, merge blocking, size/score/coupling limits.

components.name: arch_evolution
components.description: Closed-loop architecture evolution engine. Detect-mutate-evaluate-simulate-select-record-learn pipeline.

components.name: evolution_proposals
components.description: Proposal storage layer between evolution engine and architecture compiler.

components.name: architecture_objectives
components.description: Goal-directed architecture scoring. Composite objective function for ranking evolution candidates.

subsystems.name: query
subsystems.description: Graph query and context assembly. Enables structured queries, path finding, impact simulation, and LLM context building.

components.name: query_engine
components.description: Graph query language. Supports callees(), callers(), depends(), explain().

components.name: path_query
components.description: Path finding between nodes. BFS shortest path and all-paths enumeration.

components.name: context_builder
components.description: Assembles rich context for LLM consumption. Gathers node, callers, callees, intent.

components.name: simulator
components.description: Impact simulation. Predicts blast radius of changes to a node.

subsystems.name: semantics
subsystems.description: Semantic behavior extraction. Analyzes function bodies to detect actions, side effects, and data flow patterns.

components.name: semantics_engine
components.description: Extracts semantic behaviors from AST. Builds graph2 with actions and side effects.

components.name: cas
components.description: Content-addressable storage. Computes and verifies file hashes for integrity.

subsystems.name: infrastructure
subsystems.description: Core infrastructure: storage, configuration, logging, error handling, git integration. Foundation layer that all other subsystems depend on. Does NOT include the CLI entry point.

components.name: storage
components.description: File I/O with atomic writes. Manages .codegraph directory structure.

components.name: config
components.description: Configuration management. Loads codegraph.toml/pyproject.toml settings.

components.name: index
components.description: SQLite index for fast graph queries. Tables: nodes, callees, callers, layers, tests, dependency_hashes.

components.name: git_utils
components.description: Git integration. Detects changed files, gets commit info.

components.name: logging
components.description: Structured logging configuration.

components.name: recovery
components.description: Error recovery with retry and fallback strategies.

components.name: schemas
components.description: JSON schema validation for all data files.

components.name: constants
components.description: Shared constants: directory names, file names, layer values.

components.name: types
components.description: Type definitions and GraphStore protocol for graph I/O.

components.name: utils
components.description: Utility functions: formatting, hashing, file discovery, ID generation, progress reporting.

subsystems.name: architecture_memory
subsystems.description: Persists architecture decisions, refactor history, simulation results, and advisor findings so the system can learn from past architecture evolution.

components.name: architecture_memory
components.description: Stores and retrieves architecture decisions, simulation recordings, and advisor advice findings.

subsystems.name: cli
subsystems.description: Top-level CLI orchestrator. Dispatches all user commands to appropriate subsystems via lazy imports. The only module permitted to depend on all other subsystems.

components.name: cli_core
components.description: CLI entry point and foundation commands. Registers all sub-module commands.

components.name: cli_architecture
components.description: Architecture analysis and planning CLI commands.

components.name: cli_governance
components.description: Governance enforcement CLI commands: analyze, apply, policy, suggest.

components.name: cli_intelligence
components.description: Intelligence layer CLI commands: evolution, health, memory, metrics.

components.name: cli_runtime
components.description: Runtime and lifecycle CLI commands: simulate, pre-commit, branch, lifecycle.

constraints.reason: Models are pure data. They must not import engine modules.
Models must not depend on governance logic.
Models must not depend on intelligence modules.
Infrastructure is a foundation layer. It must not import governance.
Infrastructure must not import intelligence modules.
Query subsystem reads graphs. It should not depend on governance.
Semantics is independent of governance enforcement.
Models must not depend on architecture_memory.
Infrastructure must not depend on architecture_memory.
